items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.author: Wheelhouse EPOS
items.description: The Wheelhouse button, matching the .btn family in the existing app. The accent variant reads the tenant-varying --accent / --accent-dark custom properties rather than a compiled colour class, so a shop's chosen scheme still applies at runtime.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.author: Wheelhouse EPOS
items.description: Single-line text field matching .field input in the existing app: white ground so it stays legible on the shop-coloured modal background, accent focus ring, and number spinners suppressed the way the vanilla app suppresses them.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.author: Wheelhouse EPOS
items.description: Field label plus the Field stack and FieldError message that always travel with it, matching .field, .field label and .field-error. Plain elements paired by htmlFor, so it works inside the native dialog element the Wheelhouse dialog uses.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.author: Wheelhouse EPOS
items.description: Modal built on the native dialog element, so focus trapping, background inerting and Escape come from the browser. Visual parity with .modal, including the shop-configurable --modal-bg panel colour.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.author: Wheelhouse EPOS
items.description: Table markup matching table.data-table: uppercase muted headers over a 2px rule, 13.5px body, numeric columns right-aligned. Wraps itself in a horizontal scroll container because EPOS tables are wide and must not push a counter screen sideways.

items.name: money-input
items.title: Money Input
items.author: Wheelhouse EPOS
items.description: Currency field whose value is an integer number of pence and never a float. Parsing works on the digit strings and formatting divides only an exact multiple of 100, so no amount can drift a penny through rounding. Exports parsePence and formatPence for callers that need the same arithmetic outside a form.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.author: Wheelhouse EPOS
items.description: Shop-scoped table with the loading, failed and genuinely-empty states written into the component rather than left to each caller. Shop scoping is enforced by PostgreSQL row-level security on the server; this makes that scope legible in the empty and error copy.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Confirm Dialog
items.author: Wheelhouse EPOS
items.description: Replacement for the native window.confirm() the app currently calls before destructive actions. Includes a promise-based useConfirmDialog hook so call sites read the way confirm() did, and destructive confirmations ignore backdrop clicks so a stray tap on a busy counter cannot answer for staff.
